title: docs(agents): stored rows replay only what the installed release still carries
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"huangyiirene"} -->
_Requested by **Irene** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67x?thread=cmsg_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67xJhE8WhApnrf9rNZxcXpcQx)_

Fixes #28924

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:三处文字(AGENTS.md 第 12 条首要原则的最后三行,以及 `stored.ts`、`stored-migration.ts` 两个文件头注释)不再说"存储的转换永远重放";代码和行为零改动。
- **为什么改**:18.3 起 ≤16.x 的退役转换已被删除,旧说法会让 AI 告诉用户 16 时代的存储行仍然安全,与 `.changeset/25767-retire-16x-retirement-kits.md` 的 Stored rows 条目矛盾。
- **风险与回滚**:纯文字,无运行时风险;回滚即 revert 这一个 commit。
- **先看**:① `AGENTS.md` 第 253-255 行(Tier H,行数保持 3 行不变);② `packages/metadata-protocol/src/stored-migration.ts` 头注释(含对 "Not load-bearing" 段的收窄);③ `packages/spec/src/conversions/stored.ts` 头注释。
- **两分钟验证**:`git diff origin/main -- AGENTS.md`,预期只见 3 行删、3 行增,第 12 条总行数不变。
- **需要你做的**:批准(APPROVE)本 PR —— 它触及 AGENTS.md,属 Tier H,批准后由席位落地。

## What changes

Three texts that still stated the pre-18.3 policy, that every stored conversion replays forever, now say what ADR-0087 as amended (ruling 6434038284) says: rehydration replays the chain the **installed release** carries, retirement kits age out one major after their retirement, and the stored pass (`os migrate meta --stored --apply`) must run on a release that still carries a row's conversions, before the deployment moves to the release that drops them.

1. **`AGENTS.md` Prime Directive #12, lines 253-255.** Governed Tier H text. The rewrite keeps the directive at exactly its line count (3 lines removed, 3 added; the directive still spans lines 245-255), every line stays at or under 116 characters, and the sentence keeps its shape: "Stored rows: [mechanism]; [limit], so [action]. Strengthens #5." The old consequence clause ("so a consumer never needs its own accommodation for a legacy stored shape either") was dropped because it is no longer unconditionally true, and the three facts the card requires could not fit beside it in three lines.
2. **`packages/spec/src/conversions/stored.ts` header, the first policy bullet.** "D3 keeps every conversion forever precisely so any past major can replay forward" is replaced by the kit age-out rule and the stored-pass instruction; the bullet's heading now reads "The chain the installed release carries replays".
3. **`packages/metadata-protocol/src/stored-migration.ts` header.** "a row written under any past protocol is *served* canonical forever" is replaced. The same header's **Not load-bearing** paragraph, two paragraphs below, said "the read path stays the guarantee and nothing gates on this having run"; left alone it would have contradicted the corrected sentence, so it is narrowed to the window in which the release still carries a row's conversions, matching the ADR's 2026-10-26 amendment ("for those rows it is the required one, not an optional one"). This stays inside the claimed file surface (header comment only).

The wording was cross-checked against `skills/objectstack-upgrade/SKILL.md` § *Stored rows: rehydration replays what the release carries* and the **Stored rows** bullet of `.changeset/25767-retire-16x-retirement-kits.md`.

## Why

Agents read AGENTS.md as binding. After 18.3 a stored row still in a ≤16.x shape is not rewritten by any seam, so a rule saying every seam replays the full chain forever would lead an agent to tell a user their 16-era rows are safe.

## Tests

No test was added or changed: the diff is comment and rules prose only, with no behaviour to pin and no ablation owed.

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build`, exit 0 (os-verify-lock VERDICT command-exit 0).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck`, exit 0 (os-verify-lock VERDICT command-exit 0).
- `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` typecheck and tests were not run locally: the edit is inside a block comment and cannot change a type or a test result. CI's `TypeScript Type Check` and `Test Core` carry them.

## Acceptance notes

- Other comments still say the full chain replays, retired entries included, for example `packages/metadata-core/src/artifact-forward-conversion.ts`, `packages/core/src/fallbacks/authored-translation-sync.ts` and `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts`. Those describe what replays (every entry the release carries, retired ones too), which is still true, and none says "forever". They were left alone as outside this card. Carrier: none.
- No changeset: the diff changes only comments in published packages plus `AGENTS.md`, so nothing that ships changes in behaviour or API. The PR carries `skip-changeset` for that reason.

- 68 derived commands exit 0, including `check:pm-governed-prose`, `check:pm-skill-id-lint` (106 files clean), `check:pm-skill-ratchet`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check:issue-citations`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:published-files`, `check-adr-0087-registration --base origin/main`, and the spec gates `check:api-surface` (unchanged) and `check:docs` (235 generated files in sync).
- `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` first exited 3 on a shallow fixture commit; it passed (48 cases) after fetching that commit.
- NOT MEASURED, reason: each needs a full workspace build, which a comment-only diff does not justify locally, and CI builds before running them: `check:dts-closure`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:lean-entry-closure`, `check:sourcemap-no-sources-content`, and `@objectstack/lint check:doc-formula-expressions`.

</details>
